verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a broad Marketing API and Transactional API. They cover creating contacts, sending campaigns, account exports, a root resource linking all API resources, plus inbound routing, dedicated IP requests and allowlists. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity. UI-promoted features such as predictive segmentation, generative AI, Analytics AI and the drag-and-drop email builder have no evidenced API equivalents. Missing for 10: an explicit API-UI parity claim, API coverage of AI, segmentation and analytics features, email design/builder operations via API, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
